architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001 owns the ComplaintCase entity and the full complaint lifecycle
design_decisions.rationale: Complaints are a retail banking customer service function. SVC-001 holds all necessary customer and account data for investigation.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintReceived
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Increment DISP complaint counter for the relevant product category. Initialise reporting tracking.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintResolved
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Record outcome (upheld/rejected) and redress amount in DISP reporting dataset.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintClosed
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Update DISP half-yearly reporting dataset with closure timestamp and resolution days.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-015 consumes complaint events for DISP reporting — it does not participate in the complaint resolution workflow
design_decisions.rationale: Compliance's role in complaint handling is regulatory reporting and oversight, not resolution management. Event-driven consumption keeps the capabilities independent.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintReceived
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Dispatch acknowledgement notification to customer with complaint reference and regulatory timeline.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintClosed
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Dispatch resolution communication (SRC or Final Response Letter) to customer.

consumed_events.name: ComplaintReceived
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Write immutable audit record of complaint receipt. DISP 1.9.1R 3-year retention.
consumed_events.maps_to: AuditRecord with entity_type = ComplaintCase, action = received

consumed_events.name: ComplaintClosed
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-019: Write immutable audit record of complaint closure with full lifecycle summary.
consumed_events.maps_to: AuditRecord with entity_type = ComplaintCase, action = closed

cross_service_interaction_summary.purpose: DISP regulatory reporting — compliance tracks complaint statistics for FCA half-yearly submission
Customer notifications — acknowledgement and resolution communication
Immutable audit logging for DISP record retention compliance
